title: An investigation of emotion dynamics in major depressive disorder patients and healthy persons using sparse longitudinal networks
limitations: - Emotion items scored on 7-point scale treated as continuous; - Only VAR models with time lag 1 estimated; - Small sample size limited power to detect associations; - Items may not be comparable to depression symptoms; - Evening-morning interval may introduce noise; - Raw coefficients used, standardizing may yield different results
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code is available from the first author. Data is available at the University of Groningen data repository.
